verdict.rationale: Lever's AI features page explicitly claims AI Interview Transcripts and Summaries that automatically capture conversations and generate actionable recaps to speed up feedback and decisions, directly supporting the recording/transcription/summary aspect and implying scorecard integration. However, missing for 10: explicit detail on how consent is obtained/handled during recording, confirmation the summary is inserted directly into the scorecard UI, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor marketing copy.
